title: Frequency Query on Tree
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq u_i \lt v_i \leq N; The given graph is a tree.; 1 \leq x_i \leq N; 1 \leq s \lt t \leq N; 1 \leq a \leq b \leq N; All input values are integers.
